entries: Anomaly detected. Harvest has spoiled. No contingency protocol available.
检测到异常。收割已腐坏。无应急预案可用。
Yeah, that's not going to happen.
You cannot understand. Submit to harvest. Resume descent into oblivion.
你们无法理解。服从收割。继续沉入湮灭。
You seem to misunderstand our nature. Are you part of this curse?
你似乎误解了我们的本性。你是这诅咒的一部分吗？
But I have seen you. Unripe. Soon.
但我见过你们。尚未成熟。快了。
对，他说的就是我想说的。

No protocol available...

Backup Protocol: Protect Future Harvest.

无预案可用……

备用协议：保护未来收割。
Not in nature to leave unanswered. Must know!
不该留悬而未答。必须知道！
Cease interference. Probability of connection to spoilage. Inconclusive.
停止干预。与腐坏的关联概率：尚无定论。
I have not seen this creature in these halls before.
这些厅堂里，我从前没见过这种生物。
Why does it inquire? Proceed as the others do. Persist no more.
为何发问？像其他人一样前行。不要再纠缠。
What are you doing in here?
